extracted.intended_audience: Authors and implementers of MathML (markup authors, browser vendors, tool and accessibility implementers)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and normative changes for producing and validating MathML 4 presentation and content markup, including deprecated-attribute removal, required element usage, and alignment with MathML‑Core/CSS syntax. Useful for implementers, validators, and authors updating existing MathML documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negative numbers markup
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify that negative numbers should be marked up with an explicit <mo> operator in 3.2.4.4 Numbers that should not be written using <mn> alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not encode a negative number as a single <mn> token alone; use an explicit <mo> for the minus sign so the structure is unambiguous to renderers and processors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tables must use explicit rows and cells
rubrics_metrics.description: In MathML table rows and cells must be explicitly marked with <mtr> and <mtd>.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementations must not rely on inferring row or cell markup; markup authors must include <mtr>/<mtd> elements explicitly. (Previously MathML1 required inferred rows; that inference is removed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of mode and macros attributes on <math>
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove the mode and macros attributes from <math>. macros had no defined behaviour, and mode can be replaced by suitable use of display.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These attributes are deprecated and invalid in the default schema; use display and other supported mechanisms instead. The mathml4-legacy schema can be used if legacy validation is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of the other attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove the other attribute. This has been deprecated since MathML 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and validators should not use the other attribute in new documents; legacy validation can be performed via mathml4-legacy schema.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deprecated MathML1 token font attributes removed
rubrics_metrics.description: The deprecated MathML 1 attributes on token elements: fontfamily, fontweight, fontstyle, fontsize, color and background are removed in favor of mathvariant, mathsize, mathcolor and mathbackground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These older attributes are no longer valid on token elements and also no longer valid on <mstyle>; use the newer math*-prefixed attributes. Legacy documents may be validated with the mathml4-legacy schema.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deprecated font attributes dropped from <mglyph>
rubrics_metrics.description: All the deprecated font related attributes have been dropped from mglyph which is still retained to include images in MathML.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: <mglyph> remains for images but without the old font-related attributes; presentational control should use current attributes or surrounding styling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction/simplification of malignmark and table group alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: The use of malignmark has been restricted and simplified, matching the features implemented in existing implementations. The groupalign attribute on table elements is no longer supported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should avoid relying on malignmark/groupalign behavior from older specs; use the simplified/restricted features or alternative alignment mechanisms supported in implementations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of deprecated mo attributes fence and separator
rubrics_metrics.description: The deprecated mo attributes, fence and separator, have been removed (and are also no longer listed as properties in B. Operator Dictionary).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operators that previously relied on fence/separator attributes should instead be represented using current constructs; operator dictionary and spacing rules have been adjusted accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: none element replaced by empty <mrow>
rubrics_metrics.description: The deprecated element none is replaced by an empty mrow throughout, to match MathML‑Core.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use an explicit empty <mrow/> where previously none was used; none is invalid in the default schema (legacy schema may accept it).

rubrics_metrics.name: mlabeledtr and related attributes removed
rubrics_metrics.description: The element mlabeledtr and the associated attributes side and minlabelspacing are no longer specified. They are removed from the default schema but valid in the Legacy Schema.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use mlabeledtr, side, or minlabelspacing in new MathML documents validated against the default schema; migrate to supported table constructs or use mathml4-legacy only for legacy validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: mpadded extended length syntax deprecated
rubrics_metrics.description: To align with MathML‑Core, the special extended syntax for mpadded length attributes ("("+"|"-" )? unsigned-number ( ("%" pseudo-unit?) | pseudo-unit | unit | namedspace )? ) is no longer supported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most functionality is still available using standard CSS length syntax. Authors should use standard CSS length units and syntax; see "Note: mpadded lengths" for migration guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deprecated elements reln, declare, fn removed
rubrics_metrics.description: The deprecated elements reln, declare and fn have been removed. The mathml4-legacy schema makes these valid if needed for legacy applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid using these elements in new content; if converting old documents, validate using the legacy schema or rewrite constructs to current equivalents.

rubrics_metrics.name: <semantics> encoding and definitionURL invalid
rubrics_metrics.description: MathML 3 deprecated the use of encoding and definitionURL on <semantics>. They are invalid in this specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must not use encoding or definitionURL on <semantics> in MathML 4; use supported annotation methods. mathml4-legacy may validate documents that still use them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intent attribute and annotation chapter
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduced new chapter 5, 'Annotating MathML: intent', describing the intent attribute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can use the intent attribute to annotate MathML with authorial intent; consult chapter 5 for normative behavior and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: MathML color and length attributes follow MathML‑Core/CSS3 syntax
rubrics_metrics.description: Modified the definition of MathML color and length valued attributes to be explicitly based on the syntax used in MathML‑Core which in turn uses definitions provided by CSS3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Color and length attribute values must follow the CSS/CSS3-compatible syntax as defined by MathML‑Core; authors and implementers should reference the MathML‑Core and CSS specs for exact syntax rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Horizontal alignment of scripts in <mmultiscripts>
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify that the horizontal alignment of scripts in 3.4.7 Prescripts and Tensor Indices (<mmultiscripts>, <mprescripts/>) is towards the base, and add a new example.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When laying out multiscripts, align scripts horizontally toward the base (the primary symbol) rather than centering or other heuristics; see the new example in 3.4.7 for expected rendering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use src instead of href on share examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct examples in 4.2.7.1 The share element ... to use src (to match the normative schema) not href. The previous examples were also valid, as href is a common presentational attribute allowed on all elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer using src in examples and authoritative markup for the <share> element; implementers should accept src as the normative attribute. href may still appear but src is the correct normative attribute per schema.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schema refactor and legacy schema availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The schema was updated to match MathML4. The schema was refactored with a new mathml4-core schema being used as the basis for mathml4-presentation, and a new mathml4-legacy schema that can be used to validate an existing corpus of documents matching MathML3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementers and validators should adopt the new core/presentation split for schema validation. Use mathml4-legacy only to support/validate older documents while migrating to the default schemas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operator spacing/priorities reviewed and compact presentation added
rubrics_metrics.description: The spacing values and priorities of the elements were reviewed and adjusted. A new compact presentation is provided as well as the tabular presentation used previously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rendering engines should apply the updated spacing/priorities and may support the new compact presentation mode; refer to the operator dictionary changes in Appendix B for precise values.
